Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Joint Evaluation Charter + MAP (GDoc & Slides) — Helium AI

Hi Emily —

Great to connect last week. Per our call, attached are the two artifacts I promised to seed: 1) a lightweight MAP (Mutual Action Plan) GDoc and 2) a one-slide acceptance roadmap (GSlides) you can copy into your workspace. The idea is to give both teams a single source of truth for milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria during the 30-day pilot.

Quick ask from our side: could you confirm the internal stakeholders who should be able to edit the GDoc (engineering, data security, procurement)? I’ve pre-filled the first pass of milestones: kickoff, data ingest, perf baseline, compliance checklist, pilot acceptance.

If that looks good I’d like to run a 30-minute alignment tomorrow to assign owners and agree on the acceptance matrix. Proposed times: 11:00–11:30am PT or 2:00–2:30pm PT. Let me know which works.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc — outline + milestone table
- MAP_Slides_Skeleton_v1.gslides — 1-slide acceptance timeline

Notes in the template: please don’t hesitate to delete rows you don’t need. We usually recommend a minimum set of acceptance criteria: 1) throughput at 95th pctl, 2) end-to-end latency under agreed SLO, 3) data retention/segregation validated, 4) sample fidelity check on N=200 prompts.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks, Stephanie — I appreciate the fast turnaround. The artifacts look like a solid starting point. A few quick items from our side: 

- Please give edit access to: Jasper Wong (jasper.w@hel.ai, Eng lead), Priya Rao (priyaa@hel.ai, Data Security) and me.
- Can you add a short column in the MAP for ‘rollback criteria’ (what would trigger us to pause the pilot)?
- Our procurement lead (ops@hel.ai) wants the estimated committed spend for the Dedicated pilot in writing so they can fast-track a PO. Can you add an indicative figure in the finance row? We understand it’s a placeholder for now.

We can do 11:00–11:30am PT tomorrow (Tue). If you can invite Ben and Marissa from your side, that’d be great.

Also attaching the Helium technical intake checklist — it’s lightweight but will help you prep for the data ingest week.

—Emily
